name: Amazon.com RTX 3090 channel (new and Amazon Renewed)
price_basis: MSI GeForce RTX 3090 Tri Frozr and EVGA GeForce RTX 3090 FTW3 Ultra, bare card, Amazon direct, pre-tax, observed 2026-10-03. Both $1,849.99 against Amazon's own strikethrough 'New Price' of $2,269.00 and $2,299.99 respectively. Separately an RTX 3090 Founders Edition on Amazon Renewed at $1,899.99 against $2,399.00 new.
notes: The most useful thing this channel shows is how far the RTX 3090's new-condition price has moved: Amazon's own 'new price' reference for a 3090 is now $2,149.99-$2,399.00, essentially identical to Newegg's $2,399.00 and above Micro Center's flat $1,099.99 refurbished tier. So the 2020 flagship is a $2.4k new part with a $1.1k refurb alternative and a current-generation RTX 5070 Ti at $1,249.99 - which is the honest reason it is no longer the value pick for local inference in new condition. The practical Amazon-specific finding is the Renewed tier at $1,899.99 for a Founders Edition, above Micro Center's $1,099.99 refurb for any AIB 3090. '50+ bought in past month' on the EVGA listing suggests real volume on the cheaper SKUs. Note the repo's separate new-retail-rtx-5090-amazon record carries Amazon 5090 figures sourced through a price-table aggregator; this record is direct from the amazon.com search page.
